headline: Barclays Maintains Underweight on Church & Dwight Co, Lowers Price Target to $83
summary: Barclays  analyst Lauren Lieberman   maintains Church & Dwight Co (NYSE:CHD) with a Underweight and lowers the price target from $86 to $83.

headline: The Stocks That Will Get Investors Home Safe When Tech Cracks
summary: When tech stocks crack, most investors discover too late that their portfolios were far more concentrated than they realized. Jim Cramer and others are pointing to a handful of quiet winners that keep paying dividends no matter what chip stocks do.
